results.name: ConfigError
results.message: facilitatorUrl is required. Set X402_FACILITATOR_URL (e.g. https://x402.org/facilitator for Base Sepolia and Solana devnet) — x402-lens never defaults it.

results.name: ConfigError
results.message: network "base-sepolia" is not a CAIP-2 identifier. Use "eip155:84532" instead.

results.name: ConfigError
results.message: Route "GET /generate" uses scheme "upto" and also sets paymentFlow "upfront". The flow is fixed by the scheme for upto — remove paymentFlow, or use scheme "exact" if you need to choose.

results.name: ConfigError
results.message: Route "GET /weather" sets uptoFlow but uses scheme "exact". uptoFlow only applies to "upto"; use paymentFlow for exact.

results.name: ConfigError
results.message: payTo "0x209693Bc6afc0C5328bA36FaF03C514EF312287C" is not a base58 Solana public key, which Solana devnet (solana:EtWTRABZaYq6iMfeYKouRu166VU2xqa1) requires. An EVM address cannot receive on Solana — use payTo: { "solana:EtWTRABZaYq6iMfeYKouRu166VU2xqa1": "…" } to give each network its own address.

results.name: Error
results.message: [x402-lens] No scheme for namespace "cosmos". This package registers exact (and upto) schemes for eip155 and solana. For any other network, keep the returned server instance and call server.register(network, scheme) yourself.

sessions.matrix: shipped CLI against the live SUT
sessions.expectation: documented (D-20/D-08): inspect --json against the live SUT — default server (cors off) reports the browser-readiness issue and exits 1 (the documented CORS report, conformance empty); cors-on server exits 0; doctor --json against the lab facilitator exits 0 (network listed for v2)

issues.problem: Missing PAYMENT-REQUIRED, PAYMENT-RESPONSE. A cross-origin buyer cannot read them, so it never learns the price.
Missing PAYMENT-SIGNATURE. The browser strips the retry header and the payment is silently not made. Add Content-Type alongside it when requests carry a body.
